parameters.query: =INSERT INTO task (task_id, project_id, user_id, image_path, status, progress, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.task_id }}', '{{ $json.project_id }}', '{{ $json.user_id }}', '', 'pending', 0, NOW()) RETURNING task_id, project_id, user_id, status, progress, created_at

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,

  "message": "任务提交成功，正在后台处理",

parameters.query: =UPDATE task SET image_path = '{{ $node['Generate TaskID'].json.image_filename }}', status = 'uploaded', progress = 25, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = '{{ $node['Generate TaskID'].json.task_id }}' RETURNING task_id, project_id, user_id, image_path, status, progress, updated_at

=UPDATE task SET vision_result = '{{ JSON.stringify($node['Call Vision AI'].json) }}', status = 'detected', progress = 50, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = '{{ $node['Generate TaskID'].json.task_id }}'
=UPDATE task SET llm_result = '{{ JSON.stringify($node['Call LLM AI'].json) }}', status = 'generating', progress = 75, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = '{{ $node['Generate TaskID'].json.task_id }}'

=UPDATE task SET report_path = '{{ $node['Build LLM Prompt'].json.report_filename }}', status = 'completed', progress = 100, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = '{{ $node['Generate TaskID'].json.task_id }}'
=UPDATE task SET status = 'failed', error_message = '{{ $node['Error Handler'].json.error_message }}', updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = '{{ $node['Generate TaskID'].json.task_id }}'
